info.name: HIP Disease Chatbot Sessions (Step 5b/5c)
info.description:
Examples from real phpunit dumps (sqlite). Booking + Razorpay test mode + unpaid hold expiry. Requires CHATBOT_DISEASE_ENABLED=true.

## Doctor listing (profile speciality)
Doctors for CHOOSE_DOCTOR / CHOOSE_SPECIALITY match `doctors.speciality` + `doctors.hospital_ids` (same as HomePageController::scopeDoctorsForSpeciality / all-doctors-list). Slots still come from active doctor_assignments for the session hospital. CHATBOT_HIDE_DOCTORS_WITHOUT_SLOTS (default true) hides profile matches with no free slots in the horizon.

## CHOOSE_DATE
date_picker items are only dates with slots_count > 0 (available always true). If none: text "No dates are available for this doctor right now." + Choose another doctor.

## input.type values (disease chatbot envelope)

`input.type` is the value the client must send back as `input.type`. `input.mode` is the same string and is deprecated.

| input.type | When | Example request |
|---|---|---|
| `none` | Terminal / informational | — |
| `option` | Single choice (MENU, ASK_CONSULT, ASK_COINS, EXPIRED, CONFIRM_SUMMARY) | `{"type":"option","value":"check_disease"}` |
| `multi_option` | ASK_SYMPTOMS chips. `value` is an array of option ids (labels still accepted). `input.searchable` is true. `input.max` is `chatbot.max_symptoms` (default 15). | `{"type":"multi_option","value":["wheeze","cough"]}` |
| `text` | Free text on ASK_SYMPTOMS (`allow_text`) | `{"type":"text","value":"I have a cough"}` |
| `doctor` | CHOOSE_DOCTOR | `{"type":"doctor","value":"<doctor uuid>"}` |
| `date` | CHOOSE_DATE | `{"type":"date","value":"2026-10-17"}` |
| `slot` | CHOOSE_SLOT | `{"type":"slot","value":"09:00 AM"}` |
| `number` | ASK_COINS_AMOUNT | `{"type":"number","value":20}` |
| `payment` | PAYMENT_PENDING | `{"type":"payment","value":"check"}` |

Aliases still accepted: `symptoms` → `multi_option`, `payment_check` → `payment`. A request whose type does not match the current `input.type` returns 422 and names the expected type. Back and restart are always allowed. Option buttons on a doctor/date/slot/payment step are sent as `{"type":"option","value":"<option id>"}`.
